summary.text: Bill Lucas is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 115 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A U.S. Marine Corps veteran and machinist, he serves on the Corrections and Public Institutions Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lucas served in the U.S. Marine Corps, and his career experience includes working as a machinist.
For the 2025-2026 session, Lucas was assigned to the Corrections and Public Institutions Committee and the Conservation and Natural Resources Committee.
